articles.summary: As Virgin Galactic prepares the next generation of spaceships that will carry thousands of future astronauts to space, we're inviting the world to help us name one of them. Starting today, you can vote for one of four finalist names for a spaceship that will join Virgin Galactic's growing fleet and the next chapter in our journey to expand access to space.
articles.title: Name a Virgin Galactic Spaceship. Shape a Piece of Spaceflight History.
